meta.name: FIT50 voice-lint
meta.purpose: Machine-checkable subset of voice.md. The post-draft validator runs this against every generated slide and fails the post if any rule trips. Banned lists grow over time as you correct copy (see Phase 6).

banned_characters.rationale: voice.md rule 1 — full stops where you'd expect exclamation marks.

banned_emoji._comment: Slide text never carries emoji. Caption text is allowed (e.g. 👇 for 'see first comment').

banned_phrases._comment: Extend this list every time you correct copy. The Phase 6 learning loop formalises the workflow.

field_limits._comment: Max characters per field, by template. Hard cap — the generator refuses to write beyond. These match the spec's template table; if you raise one, raise the same one in tokens.json (or vice versa).

structure._comment: Carousel structural rules per voice.md rule 9.

facts_check._comment: Anything in facts.json must appear by exact name. Numbers in copy must equal a number in facts.json. voice-lint runs the post-draft facts check; this section configures it.
